stories.title: San Antonio-to-Austin rail connection gets renewed push from city councilwoman
stories.summary: District 7 Councilwoman Marina Alderete Gavito wants regional leaders to explore a rail line along I-35, with a long-term goal of reaching Dallas-Fort Worth.

stories.title: Recognize them? San Antonio police seek two suspects in bicycle theft from storage unit
stories.summary: Police say the suspects forced their way into a storage unit on South St. Mary’s Street and stole bicycles Sept. 29.

stories.title: Dense fog brings low visibility to Hill Country during chilly morning commute | Weather Impact Alert
stories.summary: A dense fog advisory lasts until 9 a.m. for parts of the Hill Country, with visibility at a quarter-mile or less before sunshine brings a warmer afternoon.

stories.title: A little change, a lot of cheer: Giving machines at Pearl help San Antonio neighbors
stories.summary: Donations ranging from $5 to $150 can support essentials and holiday gifts for children, veterans, people experiencing homelessness and seniors.

stories.title: Robert Bond vanished from a Houston townhome in 2024. His family fears he'll never come home
stories.summary: Robert Bond disappeared from a Galleria-area townhome in June 2024. His mother says the family has slowly come to believe he is dead.

stories.title: 2 Waymo cars involved in Phoenix crash, injuries reported
stories.summary: The crash occurred near 19th and Van Buren streets and involved at least four vehicles. Surveillance footage shows an oncoming vehicle hitting one of the Waymo cars.

stories.title: 'Pray for us, for her children.' | Family remembers Southside ISD police officer after fatal crash as community gathers for prayer vigil
stories.summary: Officer Lozano's sister Juanita says Christina was a good person, devoted to her faith, loved her family, and always enjoyed spending time with her grandchildren.

stories.title: Police investigating murder-suicide after disturbance call in Schertz
stories.summary: On Monday, Schertz police announced they are investigating this as a murder-suicide.

stories.title: North East ISD votes to consolidate three elementary schools, aims to save $4 million annually
stories.summary: The three schools consolidated are Dellview, Oak Grove and Montgomery. The district says the consolidation could save them $4 million a year.

stories.title: SAPD: Man shot by SWAT officers during standoff at far west-side home; woman found dead with gunshot wound inside
stories.summary: San Antonio police chief said officers responded to the home near Moon Light and Horal Drive for reports of a shooting around 2:45 p.m.

stories.title: San Antonio councilwoman pushes for high-speed rail connection to Austin
stories.summary: The Council Consideration Request comes after several House and Senate lawmakers filed new legislation in support of high-speed rail lines in Texas.

stories.title: Vacant San Antonio home engulfed in flames amid neighborhood safety concerns
stories.summary: A vacant home was engulfed by flames Saturday evening, alarming residents while the fire's cause remains under investigation.
